{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Identify rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 that are in the control arm and moderate severity
df_neg999 = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]

# Filter for control arm and moderate severity
neg999_control_moderate = df_neg999[(df_neg999['arm'] == 'control') & (df_neg999['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Count how many such rows exist
n_neg999_control_moderate = len(neg999_control_moderate)

# Also check how many patients in the target group are affected
# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# First, exclude -999 rows, deduplicate, then filter
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
control_moderate_clean = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Now, check if any of the -999 rows in control/moderate are among the deduplicated control/moderate group
# We need to see if any patient_id from neg999_control_moderate appears in control_moderate_clean
neg999_patient_ids = set(neg999_control_moderate['patient_id'])
control_moderate_patient_ids = set(control_moderate_clean['patient_id'])
overlapping_patient_ids = neg999_patient_ids & control_moderate_patient_ids

print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 in control arm and moderate severity: {n_neg999_control_moderate}')
print(f'Number of patients in this group: {len(neg999_control_moderate["patient_id"].unique())}')
print(f'Number of such patients that would have been included in the deduplicated target group: {len(overlapping_patient_ids)}')"}
